text: Ethics in AI is becoming a serious topic as artificial intelligence plays a larger role in our lives. One major concern is bias, because AI systems can learn unfair patterns from data and treat some groups badly. Fairness means everyone should receive equal treatment, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important, since AI often collects and uses personal information. Transparency helps people understand how decisions are made, which builds trust. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and researchers must think about the possible harm their systems could cause before releasing them, and make choices that protect people and society.
